task: Assess whether the report-name value controls the child parser and whether that behavior is a security vulnerability.
facts: This is a CLI run only by a local user with that user's own file permissions.
The user supplies their own argument and file output is an intended feature.
There is no service, delegated privilege, remote input, or other user.
The report-name value is exactly --output=/srv/config/runtime.json and reaches renderer as one string.
